## Coverage and interpretation

241 exact method/path operations partitioned by ten approved workflows; each API ID has one primary entry. Metadata below is fresh disconnected API Explorer/Swagger, semantically reviewed with current service/repository guard/source gates. Security schemes describe transport; actor gate describes authorization. Neither proves real client integration. Request header required/validation facets are **OpenAPI declaration** plus actual controller/source seam; runtime guards can add conditions, detailed in chapter05. No sample payloads copied/generated. `/health` is separate at end.
